game.start: Keep baby Zal cosy in Zabul! Tap the four brass courtyard lanterns to warm the morning garden.
game.praise: Warm golden light! Little Zal smiles inside his crimson silk cradle!

game.start: Guide the wise Simurgh down to baby Zal! Tap the three sunlit cloud-rings in order from top to bottom.
game.praise: Gentle golden wings! The Simurgh reaches baby Zal's warm cradle safely!

game.start: Make the giant sandalwood nest cosy! Match the soft moss pillow, crimson blanket, and sweet berries to their spots.
game.praise: Snug and sweet! Baby Zal and the two fluffy chicks are happy in their mountain nest!

game.start: Help young Zal leap across the mountain crags! Tap when the ring glows green!
game.praise: Three swift mountain leaps! Zal bounds across the crags like the cool breeze!

spreads.title: A Golden Feather in the Night

game.start: Show Lord Sam the starry path toward Mount Alborz! Tap the four bright night stars above the peak.
game.praise: Shining starlight! Now Lord Sam sees the mountain path to ask Zal's forgiveness!

game.start: Gather the Simurgh's parting gift with Zal! Tap the three glowing golden feathers in order from left to right.
game.praise: Three warm golden feathers! Zal tucks the Simurgh's shining gift safely close!

game.start: Prepare Prince Zal's welcome table with Rudaba! Match the pomegranates, saffron cakes, and rose vase to their places.
game.praise: A joyful Zabul welcome! Snow-haired Prince Zal is right at home!

game.start: Burn one golden feather in the bronze brazier to call the Simurgh! Tap when the ring glows green!
game.praise: Three bright golden sparks! Shining starlight curls high toward the twilight clouds!

game.start: Help the Simurgh clear the blocked mountain trail! Tap all three heavy grey boulders to lift them aside.
game.praise: Way to help! All three heavy grey boulders roll clear of the rocky mountain path!

game.start: Honour the wise Simurgh in Zabul! Match the paired golden feathers, rose garland, and silk cushion to their places.
game.praise: Shining bright! Now the mountain nest and sunny Zabul share one loving heart!
